messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: canary-v12 streaming p99 spike detected in us-west-2. p99 = 6.2s (SLO 5s). Spike started ~2401239800. Affected route: /v1/chat/stream. Auto-page oncall.

michael: oncall here, looking. any obvious errors in logs?

ops-bot: metric snapshot: canary-v12 qps 180, stable-v11 qps 720. streaming stalls increased from 0.4% -> 3.8% in last 5m. KV cache eviction rate jumped 8x.

sara: seeing a KV eviction cascade in the canary pods, eviction bursts coincide with long tail. suspect cache thrash after model param layout change.

ida: confirming. stack traces show frequent KV miss -> reload path on critical tokenization hot path. small requests get stalled while GPU hotstart waits for KV restore.

luca: customer-impact check: CS reports 2 customers (partner-alpha, search-saas) seeing ~20% slower response times and a few timed-out streams. no 5xxs but streaming clients are dropping.

michael: immediate mitigation options: 1) shift canary traffic back to stable (weight 0) 2) rollback canary to v11 3) disable prefix-KV caching in canary and restart. I'm for quick traffic shift + rollback if shift doesn't help.

sara: agree. I'll push a traffic-weight override to route canary->stable. running command now:

sara: ```sh
# reroute: move 100% traffic off canary
redwoodctl traffic set --route /v1/chat --version stable-v11 --weight 100 --scope canary
```

ops-bot: deployment action queued by sara at 2401239987. Expected propagation < 60s.

ida: checking metrics after reroute... p99 dropped to 2.1s within 90s, streaming stalls back down to baseline. KV evict still high on canary pods (isolated) but user-facing effect reduced.

michael: good. keep canary cordoned. please start rollback plan for v12 and capture debugging logs for model parameter layout change. sara start rollback, ida collect KV debug dump. notify CS.

sara: initiating rollback now (triggered 2401240102). curl command used: ```sh
curl -X POST $CONTROLPLANE/deployments/rollback -d '{"service":"inference","target":"v11","reason":"canary tail latency spike"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

jamie: ping from CS — we've told partner-alpha that we're rerouting traffic and investigating; they asked if any requests were lost. we have no 5xxs but some stream clients reconnected. I'll prepare a summary.

ida: collecting KV eviction traces and full hotspot flame graphs. saving to internal bucket s3://redwood-debug/2401239876-kv-dumps.tar.gz.

michael: thanks. next steps: 1) finish rollback and confirm canary pods scaled down 2) attach rollback artifact to incident 3) postmortem owner: ida 4) mitigation notes for runbook: add preflight KV layout compatibility check and soft-cache-fallback in runtime.

luca: I'll draft customer communication and coordinate with support. once rollback verified, we can unpage.

ops-bot: rollback completed at 2401240325. stable traffic confirmed. final p99 = 1.9s.

sara: closing oncall handoff: leaving notes in the incident doc and linking logs. :thumbsup:

michael: unpaging. follow-up action items assigned to ida (root cause and runbook), sara (traffic gating improvements), luca/jamie (customer comms). leaving thread open for final artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-2401239876 created, severity: P2. Postmortem due in 72h.
